why: The Container Registry card's keep: one document a minute with the registry's readings from Azure Monitor (storage, pulls, pushes, run time) and one document an hour with the catalogue read through the registry's own API: images, tags and the untagged manifests a purge would free, named and never purged. Partitioned on the UTC day and written by the SQL site alone, so a reading is never written twice. The kind, the day, the moment and the three bucket keys are indexed and nothing else, so a window is a grouped query over the index. Documents expire thirty-one days after they are written, one more than the longest window (ADR: One frame for every resource).
